description.en: Mail Merge fills a PDF form or a Word document with data from Excel or CSV and creates a PDF for each row or group of rows, with text, dates, numbers, pictures and barcodes. The documents can go into one collective PDF with bookmarks and into sub folders, get a password, be sent by e-mail through Outlook or be printed in one job. An assistant shows and checks every document before the start; jobs and a shared template library make repeat runs quick.
description.de: Serienbrief füllt ein PDF-Formular oder ein Word-Dokument mit Daten aus Excel oder CSV und erzeugt ein PDF je Zeile oder Zeilengruppe, mit Text, Datum, Zahlen, Bildern und Barcodes. Die Dokumente kommen auf Wunsch in ein Sammel-PDF mit Lesezeichen und in Unterordner, erhalten ein Kennwort, gehen per E-Mail über Outlook hinaus oder werden in einem Auftrag gedruckt. Ein Assistent zeigt und prüft jedes Dokument vor dem Start; Aufträge und eine gemeinsame Vorlagenbibliothek machen Wiederholungen schnell.
description.fr: Publipostage remplit un formulaire PDF ou un document Word avec des données Excel ou CSV et crée un PDF par ligne ou groupe de lignes, avec textes, dates, nombres, images et codes-barres. Les documents peuvent aller dans un PDF combiné avec signets et dans des sous-dossiers, recevoir un mot de passe, partir par e-mail via Outlook ou être imprimés en un seul travail. Un assistant montre et vérifie chaque document avant le lancement ; tâches et bibliothèque de modèles partagée accélèrent les reprises.
description.it: Stampa unione riempie un modulo PDF o un documento Word con dati da Excel o CSV e crea un PDF per ogni riga o gruppo di righe, con testi, date, numeri, immagini e codici a barre. I documenti possono finire in un PDF combinato con segnalibri e in sottocartelle, ricevere una password, partire per e-mail tramite Outlook o essere stampati in un unico processo. Un assistente mostra e controlla ogni documento prima dell’avvio; lavori e una libreria di modelli condivisa velocizzano le ripetizioni.
description.es: Combinar correspondencia rellena un formulario PDF o un documento de Word con datos de Excel o CSV y crea un PDF por fila o grupo de filas, con texto, fechas, números, imágenes y códigos de barras. Los documentos pueden ir a un PDF combinado con marcadores y a subcarpetas, recibir contraseña, enviarse por correo con Outlook o imprimirse en un solo trabajo. Un asistente muestra y revisa cada documento antes de empezar; los trabajos y una biblioteca de plantillas compartida agilizan las repeticiones.
description.nl: Afdruk samenvoegen vult een PDF-formulier of Word-document met gegevens uit Excel of CSV en maakt een PDF per rij of groep rijen, met tekst, datums, getallen, afbeeldingen en barcodes. De documenten kunnen in één verzamel-PDF met bladwijzers en in submappen komen, een wachtwoord krijgen, via Outlook worden gemaild of in één taak worden afgedrukt. Een assistent toont en controleert elk document vóór de start; taken en een gedeelde sjabloonbibliotheek maken herhalingen snel.
description.pt: Mala direta preenche um formulário PDF ou um documento do Word com dados do Excel ou CSV e cria um PDF por linha ou grupo de linhas, com texto, datas, números, imagens e códigos de barras. Os documentos podem ir para um PDF combinado com marcadores e para subpastas, receber senha, ser enviados por e-mail pelo Outlook ou impressos em um único trabalho. Um assistente mostra e verifica cada documento antes do início; trabalhos e uma biblioteca de modelos compartilhada agilizam as repetições.
description.da: Brevfletning udfylder en PDF-formular eller et Word-dokument med data fra Excel eller CSV og opretter en PDF pr. række eller gruppe af rækker, med tekst, datoer, tal, billeder og stregkoder. Dokumenterne kan samles i én samle-PDF med bogmærker og i undermapper, få en adgangskode, sendes som e-mail via Outlook eller udskrives i ét job. En guide viser og kontrollerer hvert dokument før start; job og et delt skabelonbibliotek gør gentagelser hurtige.
description.fi: Joukkokirje täyttää PDF-lomakkeen tai Word-asiakirjan Excelin tai CSV:n tiedoilla ja luo PDF:n jokaiselle riville tai riviryhmälle: tekstiä, päivämääriä, lukuja, kuvia ja viivakoodeja. Asiakirjat voi koota kirjanmerkein yhdistettyyn PDF:ään ja alikansioihin, suojata salasanalla, lähettää sähköpostilla Outlookin kautta tai tulostaa yhtenä työnä. Ohjattu toiminto näyttää ja tarkistaa jokaisen asiakirjan ennen aloitusta; työt ja jaettu mallikirjasto nopeuttavat toistoa.
description.nb: Utskriftsfletting fyller ut et PDF-skjema eller et Word-dokument med data fra Excel eller CSV og lager én PDF per rad eller gruppe av rader, med tekst, datoer, tall, bilder og strekkoder. Dokumentene kan samles i én samle-PDF med bokmerker og i undermapper, få et passord, sendes på e-post via Outlook eller skrives ut i én jobb. En veiviser viser og kontrollerer hvert dokument før start; jobber og et delt malbibliotek gjør gjentakelser raske.
description.sv: Dokumentkoppling fyller ett PDF-formulär eller ett Word-dokument med data från Excel eller CSV och skapar en PDF per rad eller grupp av rader, med text, datum, tal, bilder och streckkoder. Dokumenten kan samlas i en samlings-PDF med bokmärken och i undermappar, få ett lösenord, skickas via e-post med Outlook eller skrivas ut i ett jobb. En guide visar och kontrollerar varje dokument före start; jobb och ett delat mallbibliotek gör upprepningar snabba.
description.pl: Korespondencja seryjna wypełnia formularz PDF lub dokument Word danymi z programu Excel lub pliku CSV i tworzy plik PDF dla każdego wiersza lub grupy wierszy, z tekstem, datami, liczbami, obrazami i kodami kreskowymi. Dokumenty mogą trafić do zbiorczego pliku PDF z zakładkami i do podfolderów, otrzymać hasło, zostać wysłane e-mailem przez Outlook lub wydrukowane w jednym zadaniu. Kreator pokazuje i sprawdza każdy dokument przed startem; zadania i wspólna biblioteka szablonów przyspieszają powtórki.
description.cs: Hromadná korespondence vyplní formulář PDF nebo dokument Word daty z Excelu nebo CSV a vytvoří PDF pro každý řádek nebo skupinu řádků, s textem, daty, čísly, obrázky a čárovými kódy. Dokumenty mohou jít do souhrnného PDF se záložkami a do podsložek, dostat heslo, odejít e-mailem přes Outlook nebo se vytisknout v jedné úloze. Průvodce před spuštěním zobrazí a zkontroluje každý dokument; úlohy a sdílená knihovna šablon zrychlí opakování.
description.hu: A Körlevél Excelből vagy CSV-ből származó adatokkal tölt ki egy PDF-űrlapot vagy Word-dokumentumot, és soronként vagy sorcsoportonként PDF-et készít szöveggel, dátummal, számokkal, képekkel és vonalkódokkal. A dokumentumok könyvjelzős összesítő PDF-be és almappákba kerülhetnek, jelszót kaphatnak, e-mailben mehetnek az Outlookon át, vagy egy feladatban nyomtathatók. Egy varázsló indítás előtt megmutat és ellenőriz minden dokumentumot; a feladatok és a közös sablontár gyorsítja az ismétlést.
description.ru: Слияние заполняет форму PDF или документ Word данными из Excel или CSV и создает PDF для каждой строки или группы строк, с текстом, датами, числами, изображениями и штрихкодами. Документы можно собрать в сводный PDF с закладками и по вложенным папкам, защитить паролем, отправить по эл. почте через Outlook или напечатать одним заданием. Мастер показывает и проверяет каждый документ до запуска; задания и общая библиотека шаблонов ускоряют повторные запуски.
description.tr: Adres Mektup Birleştirme, bir PDF formunu veya Word belgesini Excel ya da CSV verileriyle doldurur ve her satır veya satır grubu için metin, tarih, sayı, resim ve barkod içeren bir PDF oluşturur. Belgeler yer işaretli tek bir toplu PDF'e ve alt klasörlere gidebilir, parola alabilir, Outlook ile e-postayla gönderilebilir veya tek işte yazdırılabilir. Bir sihirbaz başlamadan önce her belgeyi gösterir ve denetler; işler ve paylaşılan şablon kitaplığı tekrarları hızlandırır.
description.zh-Hans: 邮件合并使用 Excel 或 CSV 文件中的数据填写 PDF 表单或 Word 文档，并为每一行或每组行生成一个 PDF，可包含文本、日期、数字、图片和条形码。文档可以放入一个带书签的汇总 PDF 和子文件夹，可以设置密码，可以通过 Outlook 以电子邮件发送，也可以作为一个作业打印。向导会在开始前显示并检查每个文档；任务和共享模板库让重复操作更快捷。
description.zh-Hant: 合併列印使用 Excel 或 CSV 檔案中的資料填寫 PDF 表單或 Word 文件，並為每一列或每組列產生一份 PDF，可包含文字、日期、數字、圖片和條碼。文件可放入一個附書籤的彙整 PDF 和子資料夾，可設定密碼，可透過 Outlook 以電子郵件傳送，也可作為一個工作列印。精靈會在開始前顯示並檢查每份文件；工作和共用範本庫讓重複作業更快速。
description.ja: 差し込み印刷は、Excel または CSV のデータで PDF フォームや Word 文書に入力し、行ごとまたは行のグループごとに、テキスト、日付、数値、画像、バーコードを含む PDF を作成します。文書はしおり付きの 1 つの結合 PDF やサブフォルダーにまとめたり、パスワードを設定したり、Outlook でメール送信したり、1 つのジョブで印刷したりできます。ウィザードが開始前にすべての文書を表示してチェックします。ジョブと共有テンプレート ライブラリで繰り返しの作業もすばやく行えます。
description.ko: 편지 병합은 Excel 또는 CSV 데이터로 PDF 양식이나 Word 문서를 채우고, 행 또는 행 그룹마다 텍스트, 날짜, 숫자, 그림, 바코드가 들어간 PDF를 만듭니다. 문서는 책갈피가 있는 하나의 통합 PDF와 하위 폴더에 넣거나, 암호를 지정하거나, Outlook을 통해 전자 메일로 보내거나, 하나의 작업으로 인쇄할 수 있습니다. 도우미가 시작 전에 모든 문서를 보여 주고 확인합니다. 작업과 공유 서식 파일 라이브러리로 반복 작업이 빨라집니다.
description.ar: يملأ دمج المراسلات نموذج PDF أو مستند Word ببيانات من Excel أو CSV، وينشئ ملف PDF لكل صف أو مجموعة صفوف، مع نصوص وتواريخ وأرقام وصور ورموز شريطية. يمكن وضع المستندات في ملف PDF مجمّع بإشارات مرجعية وفي مجلدات فرعية، أو حمايتها بكلمة مرور، أو إرسالها بالبريد الإلكتروني عبر Outlook، أو طباعتها في مهمة واحدة. يعرض المساعد كل مستند ويتحقق منه قبل البدء، وتجعل المهام ومكتبة القوالب المشتركة التكرار سريعًا.

thirdParty.name: Microsoft WebView2 SDK (headers and static loader)

complianceAudit.method: Checked every #include and linker input of the store project (Windows SDK, MFC/ATL, GDI+, CryptoAPI/CNG and the Tungsten Power PDF Plugin SDK), the bundled UILayout, assets and docs (icons generated by gen_store.py, logo.png is Tungsten's own Power PDF logo), copied code, secrets and personal data (none; the only contact data is the support address in the manifest fields author/contactEmail, shown in the catalog on purpose), and all network code. The plug-in opens no network connection of its own; mail goes only through the user's own Outlook when the user switches it on (2.0.0, see below). 1.4.0: Excel workbooks are read with own code (ZIP, deflate and XML reader, no third-party code); the http://purl.oclc.org/... strings in the binary are XML namespace names of the Office file format that the reader compares, no connection is ever made. ShellExecuteW only opens the output folder, the log or one created PDF when the user clicks the button for it (CWE-78: fixed verb, paths from the run, no command line). Remembered settings: a JSON file in %APPDATA%\Tungsten\FeaturePack\MailMerge (CWE-377: own folder, written via a temp file and an atomic rename). 1.5.0: Word templates (.docx/.dotx) are filled with own code (ZIP and XML) into a copy in %TEMP%\MailMerge (deleted after each document); then the Microsoft Word installed on the PC is started invisibly through COM automation (CoCreateInstance of Word.Application, local server) only to export that copy as PDF. Macros are switched off for everything it opens (AutomationSecurity = force disable), alerts are off, the copy is opened read-only with empty passwords so a protected document fails instead of asking, macro-enabled documents (.docm/.dotm) are refused before Word is involved (CWE-94), and Word is ended when the window closes. Nothing is sent anywhere. CWE-611/776: the own XML reader (mailmerge/ooxml/sc_xml.cpp) refuses every DOCTYPE, so no DTD, no internal or external entity is ever processed; only the five predefined entities and character references are decoded, depth, node and attribute counts are limited (tested with an external entity, a nested entity expansion and an undefined entity: the template is refused). The ZIP reader limits entry sizes and the compression ratio. mailmerge/ui/mailmerge.html is not a source file: it is generated at build time from mailmerge.src.html by the kit's inline.py (prebuild step). 1.6.0: pictures the user names in the data (JPEG, PNG, GIF, BMP, TIFF) are decoded with GDI+ of Windows (files up to 30 MB and 30000 pixels per side, else refused; CWE-400), only from paths the user chose (data file folder, a picture folder or a file picked in the window). Barcodes (QR Code, Code 128, EAN-13) are encoded with own code (mailmerge/mm_barcode.cpp, no third-party code); the pictures and barcodes are drawn into the copy of the template (PDF image objects and paths, or pictures in the Word copy), the template itself is never changed. 2.0.0: (1) Collective PDF and password protection through the Power PDF SDK (DDDocInsertPages, standard security handler, AES-256); a document to protect is made in the work folder, protected there, checked (trailer /Encrypt entry and a second open without password) and only then moved to the output folder; when the protection fails it is DELETED, so no unprotected copy reaches the output folder (CWE-311). Passwords are typed by the user or come from a data column; they are never written to disk, the log, job files or the remembered settings (CWE-312/532), the check warns when a password column is used in a file name or a mail text, and the copies of a run are wiped from memory after it (SecureZeroMemory); a missing owner password is a random one (BCryptGenRandom). (2) E-mail: only when the user switches it on, through the classic Outlook installed on the PC (COM automation of Outlook.Application, local server; no SMTP, no own network code, no credentials). Default is drafts; sending at once needs a confirmation in the page, a trial run only makes drafts, an administrator policy can forbid mail or allow drafts only. Addresses are checked (no spaces or line breaks, CWE-93), the body is HTML-escaped (CWE-79). (3) Printing opens the print set in Power PDF and shows Power PDF's own print dialog (DVDocDoPrint); nothing is printed without it. (4) Job files (.mmjob, JSON, passwords removed) are written via a temp file and an atomic rename (CWE-377) and read with a size limit and the non-throwing JSON parser after a nesting check (CWE-674); network paths in a job file count only on the share of the job file itself, so a received job cannot make Windows sign in to a foreign server (CWE-200); the template library only lists a folder the user or the administrator chose. (5) Output paths: file and folder names from the data are sanitised (no \, /, :, .., device names; CWE-22), the page may only open files inside the output folder. Mail attachments named in the data must lie in the folder of the data file or below it (canonical path check, CWE-22/200). (6) Help (2.1.0): docs/help/<lang>.html + help.json are our own help pages (generated by make_help.py from our manual sources, allow list of plain HTML elements, no script, no remote content; CWE-79). They are shown by the central help of the Add-on Store (HFT TungstenAddonHelp, add-on id and a topic of [a-z-] only) or, without it, opened with ShellExecuteW (fixed verb, own file, language code [a-z]{2} only; CWE-78/22). 2.1.0: (7) Audit log (only when switched on or forced by policy): a CSV file in the output folder with time, Windows user and computer name, event, file name, SHA-256 of each written file (Windows CNG) and a hash chain; for mails the recipient address. Written with CREATE_NEW, then read-only; cells starting like a formula are prefixed (CWE-1236). (8) Payment QR codes (EPC, Swiss QR-bill) and the letter salutation are made with own code from the data, offline. (9) Formatted mail text: the page editor's HTML is cleaned on the host by an allow list (b, i, u, p, br, lists, span, div, a with http/https/mailto only; script/style/comments dropped), data values are HTML-escaped (CWE-79). (10) Flatten draws field appearances into the page with own code (standard font Helvetica, WinAnsi) and removes the widgets; signature fields stay. Temporary files live in %TEMP%\MailMerge; they are removed after use, what an ended session left is removed when the assistant opens again (older than an hour). Since 1.2.0 the assistant window is a local page of the Tungsten Plug-in UI (own code, MIT) in WebView2 (Microsoft WebView2 SDK, BSD-3-Clause; the Edge WebView2 Runtime is part of Windows); the page is inlined into the plug-in, may not navigate, open windows, download or ask for permissions, and talks to the plug-in only through JSON messages (nlohmann/json 3.12.0, MIT, header-only); without WebView2 the classic dialog is shown. Since 1.3.0 the pages also carry, as data embedded at build time, the brand font Red Hat Display 1.023 (SIL Open Font License 1.1, which allows embedding; declared in thirdParty, licence text in LICENSES.md) and the Tungsten Automation logo 2026 (original SVG of the Brand Book November 2026, property of Tungsten Automation).
